inputs.name: SessionRepository.constructor.options
inputs.description: Provides the backing SessionStore, AuthSecrets service, and clock. The clock supplies timestamps used when issuing, checking expiry, and revoking sessions.

inputs.name: SessionRepository.issue.grant
inputs.description: Provides kind, actor, resource, and parentHash, which are copied into the new SessionRecord. Only kind === "native" selects the native TTL; all other values use the browser TTL.

inputs.name: SessionRepository.find.credential
inputs.description: Credential presented for lookup; find hashes it with purpose session before querying the store. The repository code accepts the supplied string without validating its format.

inputs.name: SessionRepository.live.idHash
inputs.description: Hash key passed directly to SessionStore.find by live. A record is returned only when it exists, has revokedAt === null, and expires strictly after the current clock value.

inputs.name: SessionRepository.revoke.record
inputs.description: Stored SessionRecord supplied to revoke; the repository reads its idHash and passes that with the current clock value to the store. It does not inspect the record's other fields here.

inputs.name: SessionRepository.revokeIssuedFrom.parentHash
inputs.description: Hash identifying the origin whose issued sessions should be revoked. revokeIssuedFrom passes it with the current clock value to SessionStore.revoke.

outputs.name: BROWSER_TTL
outputs.description: Browser-session lifetime in milliseconds, selected for every issued grant whose kind is not native. Its value is seven days.

outputs.name: NATIVE_TTL
outputs.description: Native-session lifetime in milliseconds, selected when an issued grant has kind native. Its value is thirty days.

outputs.name: SessionRepository.issue
outputs.description: Resolves to the generated credential and created session record after SessionStore.create completes. The record stores a purpose-session hash of the credential, uses the TTL selected by kind, and begins with revokedAt set to null.

outputs.name: SessionRepository.find
outputs.description: Resolves to the live record for the credential or null when its hash is unknown, expired, or revoked. The credential is hashed with purpose session before the live-record check.

outputs.name: SessionRepository.live
outputs.description: Resolves to the live record for idHash, or null if no record exists, it has been revoked, or expiresAt is not greater than the current clock value. Expiry uses a strict greater-than comparison.

outputs.name: SessionRepository.revoke
outputs.description: Resolves after asking the store to revoke record.idHash at the current clock value. The repository passes no other record fields to the store.

outputs.name: SessionRepository.revokeIssuedFrom
outputs.description: Resolves after asking the store to revoke parentHash at the current clock value. The method ends sessions issued from that origin, such as a pending email proof.
